title: Not finished yet
summary: What is off or still being tested in this first version.

sections.heading: Off in Coop
steps: Enlistment, duels, the White Walker start and ravens are off.
Dragons are not tested in Coop yet.
Changing the storyline wars is off too. The game says so when you try.

sections.heading: Still being tested
steps: Sieges are still being tested. In some tests the siege menu showed only Leave, with no way to start the assault.
One big battle at Casterly Rock stopped near the end.
A few Realm of Thrones details, like militia sizes, may show the old state on your PC until Coop sends them.
